description: check_names (line 1385-1418) is a closure taking require_match: bool. Call sites are check_names(..., false) and check_names(..., true). A reader sees 'false' and 'true' without knowing which is 'excluded check' and which is 'permitted check'. An enum CheckMode { Excluded, Permitted } or splitting into two functions (already filed as PKIX-vjc.14 for elegance) would eliminate this. The bool parameter forces the caller to remember the convention. Since this is an internal closure the impact is limited to the maintainer, but the pattern is still anti-idiomatic.
title: check_names closure require_match: bool is opaque at call sites
